title: Composed majority influence identity
statement: For every natural number $m$, the total influence of the composed majority function on sign vectors of dimension $2+(2m+1)$ equals $1+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$ plus its influence error, where the influence error is the total influence minus $1+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\sqrt{2m+1}$.
